sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: walking (his move loop): a slow, looming glide forward, the robe swaying, the sickle trailing in his far hand and the lantern swinging in his near hand, the FEET under the hem STEPPING IN TURN
sheets.weapons: THE CHAIN SICKLE AND THE LANTERN go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the CHAIN SICKLE in his FAR hand - its curved blade glowing pale green - and, wherever the pale figure swings or flings it, the CHAIN drawn link by link from his hand to the sickle, exactly as long and as curved as the pale figure's; the GREEN LANTERN in his NEAR hand, hanging by his feet or raised as the pale figure holds it. Only these: no flying souls, no green trails, no rings.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: the NEAR foot (the lighter one) stepping forward under the hem, the far foot behind, exactly as the pale figure. The two feet TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR foot (the lighter one) leads, in frames 5-8 the FAR foot (the darker one) - frames 1 and 5 must look different: the other foot in front. Follow the pale figure's FEET exactly; never the same foot in front in every frame (Talon's first run did that: 「走路没有换腿」).

sheets.weapons: THE CHAIN SICKLE AND THE LANTERN go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the CHAIN SICKLE in his FAR hand - its curved blade glowing pale green - and, wherever the pale figure swings or flings it, the CHAIN drawn link by link from his hand to the sickle, exactly as long and as curved as the pale figure's; the GREEN LANTERN in his NEAR hand, hanging by his feet or raised as the pale figure holds it. Only these: no flying souls, no green trails, no rings.
